findings.observed: The allowed class sets (environmentClasses) and the emitter (environmentClass()) are two parallel sources of truth. A new class added to the emitter but not to the set would be refused at receipt time. That fails closed, and the new accept-all test pins the two together for every emitted class.

regression_proof.description: Adding an emitted class without a matching set entry fails 'accepts every emitted environment class'.

manual_checks.evidence: The baseline 1678d6aa makeReceipt validated className with /^[a-z-]+$/, which rejects the digit in 'local-pg17', so every db receipt from a local PG17 suite threw 'invalid receipt input' during receipt generation. Reproduced in a disposable probe worktree: the candidate's new tests run against the baseline gate-proof.mjs fail 2 of 10 with 'invalid receipt input' at the old regex line. The failure was reproduced at unit level, not on the combined 2A.2d tree ae43f194.

The new test calls environmentClass() for all eight (phase, requires) shapes the emitter distinguishes, asserts each emitted name, then creates and verifies a receipt for each. environmentClasses is a finite per-phase map exactly matching the emitter's outputs: static {static-local}, server {local-render, production-startup}, db {production-database, local-pg17, local-pglite}, recovery {isolated-fixture-recovery, owner-artifact-recovery}.

The test rejects local-pg18, local-pg17-extra, a trailing-space variant, an uppercase variant, an underscore variant, the empty string and db17, plus the valid-but-wrong-phase static-local in the db phase. The last is a tightening: the old regex accepted any lowercase-dash name in any phase. A non-string className fails the Set.has lookup. verifyReceipt is unchanged and still requires environment_class === the expected class.

The only runtime change is the className predicate in makeReceipt. The tree/manifest/test-hash regexes, phase check, passed >= 1, runId format, HMAC body and verifyReceipt (exact keys, tree/manifest/suite/test/phase/class binding, timingSafeEqual) are unchanged. The sole caller (line 184) passes the run phase and environmentClass(manifest[suite]). No manifest classification, phase selection or missing/skipped/failed handling changed.
